justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear low-relief carving including at least one profile quadruped-type creature on a plain ground. A shows a crowded narrative battle scene with human archers, a siege engine, and an architecturally rendered walled city with gate and crenellations, while B shows isolated, sparse animal motifs (a quadruped above an elongated creature) stacked vertically on a narrow pillar with no human figures, no architecture and no narrative interaction.
